messages:
alex: Heads up — I'm on standby for the midnight canary (eu-west). Tried to claim the deploy but the deployer role MFA is failing after last night's rotation. deploy-bot: cannot start - missing deployer:prod scope. Anyone else able to press?

maya: I can't press either, MFA app shows 'token invalid' — got kicked after the SA rotation. Did we forget a vault role update? :thinking:

jin: Checking now. We rotated the service account yesterday but I see one vault role still points to the old key. Paging @ops-oncall to hold the window.

ops-oncall: Oncall here. Can we delay 30m? If we need a rollback, who has sudo for 1.2.4 -> 1.2.3 pin?

sam: I can do a rollback, but I don't have deploy-bot perms — only release-signer. Not safe to full-roll without deployer.prod.

lena: @alex can you paste the exact command you attempted?

alex: the command was: `./scripts/release.sh --env prod --service api --version 1.2.4 --canary 2% --region eu-west`

deploy-bot: [system] Attempting canary: version=1.2.4 target=2% region=eu-west. Permission denied: missing role 'deployer.prod'.

maya: Is emergency-deployer JIT still an option? That role can be short-lived but needs security approval.

jin: Security console shows a pending JIT approval for 'emergency-deployer' until 02:15 UTC. @security-team can you confirm?

security-team: Approving JIT for alex for 30 minutes (02:15 -> 02:45 UTC) with conditions: no schema migrations, no data exports. All actions will be audited. :white_check_mark:

alex: Acknowledged. Will not run migrations. Starting canary once token is issued.

ops-oncall: Monitoring plan: if latency increases >20% or error rate >1% we rollback to 1.2.3. I'll watch tracing, logs, and the canary dashboard.

sam: Release notes updated with CVE and revert guidance. Tag pushed: github.com/redwood/r/1.2.4. Feature flags are off for experimental paths.

lena: Also — we need a runbook update: sync vault roles with KMS after SA rotation. That step was missed.

alex: Who can press the full rollout if the canary is healthy? I still need someone with deployer.prod to hit 100%.

jin: I can be available to press full rollout in +30m if the JIT token is still valid. If not, we'll re-request.

deploy-bot: [system] Canary started 02:07 UTC — 2% traffic diverted to version 1.2.4 in eu-west.

maya: Observability shows a short 5xx spike on one instance, investigating stack traces now. :mag:

alex: Pausing canary — aborting rollout. deploy-bot: abort request issued.

deploy-bot: [system] Rollback initiated. Restoring version 1.2.3 in eu-west.

deploy-bot: [system] Rollback complete. 1.2.3 restored and all canary traffic removed.

ops-oncall: Good call pausing. Action item: add a preflight check to verify SA->vault role sync before any deploy that follows a rotation.

lena: Filing ticket INF-4321: 'deployer role rotation -> vault sync race condition' (assigning to infra).

alex: Thanks everyone. Will schedule a rotation freeze in the release calendar next time and add a CI preflight that checks vault role targets before enabling deployer roles. :raised_hands:
